summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 consolidated results earnings presentation, dated November 11, 2026, with signature by attorney-in-fact Leonardo Marinaro. The filing contains no transaction terms, no price per share, no stake, no board recommendation and no advisor. It is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, the US-equivalent of a quarterly results release, not a special situation. Nothing here changes capital structure or control. What to watch: ordinary operating and regulatory developments only.
